subject: plan_run
description: Rename a shared helper used by two nested services and change its rounding, as a two-phase plan run. The verifier runs every package's tests and checks the old name is gone.

phases.title: Change the shared helper
acceptanceCriteria: packages/money exports toMinorUnits and no longer exports toCents
toMinorUnits rounds half away from zero: toMinorUnits(1.005) is 101, toMinorUnits(-1.005) is -101

steps.title: Rename toCents to toMinorUnits and fix its rounding

phases.title: Move the services over
acceptanceCriteria: No file in the workspace mentions toCents
